title: World BEYOND War Europe Berlin/Wanfried/network expansion
summary: Advanced the unresolved WBW Europe graph into the current Europe Network, Berlin chapter, and International Peacefactory Wanfried, with explicit and inferred network edges plus two public people whose historical/current evidence status is preserved.

provenance.method: bounded current first-party chapter/network expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Treat the current Europe page and dedicated chapter pages as explicit current chapter/network evidence.
Store Europe Network membership of listed European chapters as inference because the network-description and chapter-listing statements are separate but mutually supporting.
Preserve Heinrich Buecker's chapter-leader role as a 2021 explicit observation with current role unresolved.
Preserve Christian Neie-Marwede's 2024 public participation and Europe-networking activity as dated observations rather than silently promoting them to current formal office.
data.method: Follow unresolved World BEYOND War Europe leads from the prior Romania/Ireland pass; resolve current Berlin, Wanfried, and regional-network structure and then enumerate public people tied to those nodes.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which current WBW Europe network/chapter nodes and public person edges can be materialized from first-party sources while preserving dated role status and inference boundaries?

findings.finding: World BEYOND War's current Europe page identifies the WBW Europe Network, says it was born in 2024, and lists Berlin and International Peacefactory Wanfried as current European chapters.

The current Berlin chapter page confirms the chapter remains listed and active as an organizational node; its embedded first-party archive links identify Heinrich Buecker as a Berlin chapter leader in 2021, but this pass did not establish that the role remains current.
The current International Peacefactory Wanfried page identifies it as a WBW chapter and links its independent public website.
A 2024 first-party volunteer profile states Christian Neie-Marwede participated in Wanfried activities and worked on networking among European WBW chapters and affiliates.
